makeover_style: Transform this front garden into a beautifully maintained version of itself: healthy striped lawn, tidy edges, weeded and freshly mulched borders planted with cottage-garden perennials (lavender, salvia, foxgloves), pressure-washed path and driveway. Keep the house, windows, doors, walls, fences, cars and street exactly as they are — same camera angle, same lighting, photorealistic. Only improve the garden and planting.

copy.headline: Your garden, reimagined.

copy.body: A local landscaping team can make this real. No obligation, no pressure — if you'd like a free quote for anything in the picture (or your own ideas), get in touch and quote your house code.
